description:
You are a call center supervisor preparing to launch a Net Promoter Score (NPS) customer satisfaction survey for a telecom company. You need to create an agent call script in Vicidial so that agents have guided talking points during each survey call.

Log in to Vicidial Admin (username: 6666, password: andromeda) at http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php and navigate to the Scripts section under Admin.

Create a new script with these properties:
- Script ID: NPS_TELECOM_2025
- Script Name: Telecom NPS Customer Survey
- Script Comments: Net Promoter Score survey for telecom customer satisfaction campaign
- Active: Y

In the Script Text field, write HTML-formatted script content that includes ALL of the following:
1. A greeting that uses the dynamic tokens --A--first_name--B-- and --A--last_name--B-- to address the customer by name
2. A reference/info line showing the customer phone number using the token --A--phone_number--B--
3. The standard NPS question: 'On a scale of 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend our service to a friend or colleague?'
4. A follow-up question asking for the primary reason behind their score
5. A polite closing and thank-you statement

Save the script when complete.
